title: The 'Buy Now Pay Later' Trap, Explained
summary: Video on consumer debt argues BNPL checkout design exploits psychological tricks to grow basket size and keep users in cycles of multiple loans.

assertions.quote: they exploit what psychologists call the pain of paying
our tendency to value immediate rewards more than future benefits
brands are willing to pay 2 to 3% more for their transaction fees to use a buy now pay later program
they actually harvest a lot of the data from your checkout pages and then sell it to other brands

verdicts.note: Plausible given general fintech data-monetization practices, but not independently documented for the specific major BNPL providers at the scale implied.

CFPB's market-monitoring review found that 'none of the five lenders surveyed directly sells data to third parties,' though all use collected data for first-party targeting, modeling, and product design -- contradicting the specific claim that BNPL providers sell users' shopping data to other brands.

assertions.quote: in 2022, 63% of buy now pay later borrowers had more than one loan going at one time

verdicts.note: CFPB finds about 63% of BNPL borrowers originated multiple simultaneous loans at some point in 2022, and 33% took out loans from multiple BNPL lenders.

assertions.quote: over 69% of buy now pay later users are already in debt on another credit card

verdicts.note: Directionally consistent with CFPB findings that BNPL users tend to have more existing debt, though the specific majority figure cited is not independently verified here.

FEDS Notes table 2: 26% of adults who carried a credit card balance most/all of the time used BNPL, versus just 6% of those who never carried a balance -- showing a strong correlation between card debt and BNPL use.

assertions.quote: treat your credit cards in a buy now pay later program as if it's hooked directly up to your checking account

verdicts.note: Consistently recommended by consumer advocates (Bankrate, Consumer Reports) as the main way to avoid BNPL's common pitfalls.
